newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mirabell share issue 190.5 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Mirabell share issue 190.5 times subscribed.

text.p: Mirabell International Holdings Ltd said on Monday its new issue of 60 million shares of HK$0.10 each at HK$1.22 per share has been 190.5 times subscribed.
The group, involved in operating retail footwear outlets, said in a statement it received 3,832 applications for a total of 10.29 billion shares.
Its market capitalisation amounts to HK$293 million.

Some HK$63 million in net proceeds were expected from the issue, of which HK$19 million would be used in setting up new outlets, HK$15 million to buy a warehouse and administrative office in Hong Kong, it said.
Up to HK$10 million would be used to repay bank loans and the balance HK$19 million as general working capital.
Dealing of shares in Hong Kong would begin on December 6.
